name: PROBE
description: PROBE is a process-based benchmark for hallucination detection in large language models, decomposing the task into claim decomposition, evidence finding, evidence evaluation, and hallucination localization. It contains 12,000 test cases across summarization, question answering, and style transfer tasks, enabling detailed evaluation of hallucination detection capabilities.
reputation: A very recent, niche benchmark from the hallucination-detection literature; it is not yet widely adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Breaks hallucination detection into four steps for granular evaluation; finetuning improves evidence finding.
